name: reach-mcp
summary: Multi-source search MCP server for AI agents. Search Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, GitHub, arXiv, Polymarket, 微博, 知乎, 豆瓣, 头条, 雪球, V2EX, B站, 小宇宙 & more — 30 sources across Chinese & English platforms with adjustable time window, source/category scoping, trending hot lists, and optional LLM synthesis.
